definitions.gloss: formal dress; full dress; formal attire
definitions.explanation: Clothing appropriate for formal occasions such as ceremonies, official events, and important social gatherings. Includes both Western formal wear and traditional Japanese formal kimono.

examples.japanese: {正装|せいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}して→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正装|せいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Formal attire is required for weddings.

examples.japanese: {授賞式|じゅしょうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{正装|せいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えて→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I changed into formal attire and headed to the venue for the award ceremony.

notes:
USAGE:
{正装|せいそう} can also be used as a suru verb ({正装|せいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to dress formally). It covers both Western formal wear (suits, tuxedos, evening gowns) and Japanese formal wear (⟦{和装|わそう}→和装：21261_wasou⟧ such as {紋付袴|もんつきはかま}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正装|せいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧ (to attend in formal dress)
- {正装|せいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧ (formal dress is required)
- {正装|せいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧ (to change into formal attire)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{礼服|れいふく}→礼服：18440_reifuku⟧ refers specifically to the garments themselves (formal clothing), while {正装|せいそう} refers more broadly to the act or state of being formally dressed. ⟦{盛装|せいそう}→盛装：21668_seisou⟧ means to dress up elaborately, which may go beyond what is strictly formal.
